findings.description: Absolute claim overstates the gap. 'Without ICESCR ratification, no binding international framework requires the U.S. to progressively realize economic rights for its residents.' The word 'no' makes this categorical. Domestic statutory frameworks (ADA, Social Security Act, FMLA) and other treaty obligations provide partial coverage of economic rights, though not through a unified rights-based instrument. The companion post (icescr-at-fifty, line 80) acknowledges in its own epistemic flags that 'domestic frameworks provide partial coverage' — the text here should match that nuance.
findings.suggestion: Qualify the claim: 'no binding *international* framework requires the U.S. to progressively realize *the full spectrum of* economic rights' or 'no unified rights-based instrument requires...' — preserving the substantive point while acknowledging partial domestic coverage.
findings.context: Without ICESCR ratification, no binding international framework requires the U.S. to progressively realize economic rights for its residents. As AI automation accelerates displacement across entire sectors of the economy, that gap grows wider.

findings.description: Interpretive connection presented as established structural function. 'Economic rights (Articles 22-27) serve a specific structural function: they address the material conditions that, when absent, make populations vulnerable to the exact manipulation Einstein described.' This frames a plausible interpretive reading as established fact about the drafters' intent. The post's own epistemic flags acknowledge that 'direct documentation of specific drafters reading [the Einstein-Freud correspondence] remains sparse,' yet this sentence asserts the structural connection without hedging.
findings.suggestion: Add hedging language: 'Economic rights (Articles 22-27) can be understood as serving a structural function: they address the material conditions...' or 'In this reading, economic rights...' — preserving the analytical insight while marking it as interpretation rather than documented intent.
findings.context: The UDHR's structure reflects this insight. It does not merely enumerate freedoms. It establishes a framework of mutual obligation... Economic rights (Articles 22-27) serve a specific structural function: they address the material conditions that, when absent, make populations vulnerable to the exact manipulation Einstein described.
